response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.optvolrt, t.transreg, tr.tradekind
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg
  FROM matched
), pairs AS (
  SELECT transreg, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY transreg, tradekind
), deviations AS (
  SELECT p.transreg, p.tradekind, p.avg_optvolrt,
         ABS(p.avg_optvolrt - o.overall_avg) AS deviation
  FROM pairs AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
), scored AS (
  SELECT d.*,
         AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation
  FROM deviations AS d
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS average_option_volume_ratio,
       AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation,
       AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS average_excess
FROM scored
WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation
GROUP BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: “Deviation” means absolute distance from the overall average, computed from matched sentiment snapshot rows; the comparison and final averages are over transaction-reference/trader-type pairs. SQL AVG ignores missing ratios, and pairs with a missing pair average or missing overall average do not qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: If deviation means signed difference from the overall average, where above-average pairs have positive deviation, replace the ABS expression with a signed subtraction.
